title: Pack
description: Pack manifest (pack.yaml, ADR-0010): shareable metadata for a rule pack. `spec.phase` is a rollout-phase **ceiling** over contained MergePolicy rules (D-017 B2 / P3-E4-S01) — never additive: pack off evaluates none of its rules regardless of each rule's phase; pack observe caps every contained rule at observe even if the rule declares enforce; pack enforce lets each rule's own declared phase stand. Required — no default (no-implicit-enforce-phase).

phase.description: Ceiling over every rule in this pack. Adversarial: a rule declared phase:enforce inside a pack declared phase:observe must never contribute to decision/blocks/score.total — same exclusion guarantee as DecisionRecord findings.observed, composed one level up.
